title: Choose Urban Signal’s visual world
question: Which world should turn a complex civic-data system into an experience worth exploring?

options.label: The Urban Observatory
options.lineage: municipal cartography light tables and layered planning transparencies
options.thesis: The city becomes a luminous evidence surface, with every signal revealed as a physical layer.
options.viewport: A dark cartographic field fills the first screen while stacked civic-data layers peel apart under the headline.
options.risk: It demands disciplined restraint so atmosphere never obscures technical proof.

raised.raise: Every deep dive now begins with a single unmistakable next decision.
Live and derived signals gain honest, kinetic state rather than decorative motion.
Scale shifts are allowed to become genuinely monumental at narrative turns.

options.label: The Civic Evidence Atlas
options.lineage: metropolitan planning atlases, survey plates, and annotated field books
options.thesis: Urban Signal reads like the definitive atlas of how cities disclose change.
options.viewport: An oversized metro plate, marginal notes, and a red evidence thread introduce the system as a browsable field atlas.
options.risk: This is the most familiar high-craft direction for an explanatory civic-data product.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: The pipeline becomes a chain of precise decisions, always showing where the visitor is and what comes next.
options.viewport: A monumental yellow sign routes visitors toward Live demo, Explore the system, or Choose a city in under ten seconds.
options.case: Wins product clarity, but identifies less strongly with spatial intelligence than the observatory.
options.risk: Strict wayfinding can make long-form explanation feel like transit instructions.

options.label: VU Signal Bridge
options.thesis: Nine cities become live channels whose needles reveal momentum, coverage, and pipeline activity at a glance.
options.viewport: A panoramic row of nine calibrated city meters responds as the visitor scrubs across the municipal signal timeline.
options.case: Strong audience identification through the product name and mechanism; weaker for quiet reading and source documentation.
options.risk: The signal metaphor becomes novelty if every value cannot be explained honestly.

options.label: The Sleeping City Fold
options.lineage: surreal night maps folded like quilts
options.thesis: The city’s hidden activity rises from a night map as neighborhoods fold open into their data stories.
options.viewport: A recognizable night city folds upward into permit, complaint, license, and deed layers as dawn moves across the page.
options.case: Wins emotional identification with cities, but cannot match the observatory’s technical clarity.
options.risk: The poetic world may imply speculative storytelling where the product needs evidence.

options.label: Hybrid Data Collage
options.thesis: Code, maps, formulas, and screenshots collide as a single layered digital broadside.
options.viewport: A wall-scale collage makes the repository’s technical layers physically overlap.
options.case: The form carries ambition but loses both audiences when dense evidence competes for the same plane.
options.kept: Monumental scale changes at the moments when the pipeline changes meaning.
options.risk: Layer collision can make source provenance harder to follow.

options.label: Seasonal Signal Arrangement
options.thesis: Each city is a restrained arrangement whose few visible signals reveal balance, season, and change.
options.viewport: One asymmetric city signal arrangement occupies a field of charged negative space.
options.case: Beautiful for one city, but loses clarity and scalability across the full codebase and nine metros.
options.kept: Protect negative space so dense explanations arrive in deliberate breaths.
options.risk: Metaphorical sparsity conflicts with the request for thorough explanation.

canonCard.label: The polished geospatial SaaS standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark map hero, crisp product cards, architecture diagram, city grid, and clear demo CTA executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A split hero pairs a direct product promise with a polished dashboard preview and immediate demo action.
canonCard.risk: It is legible and credible but intentionally resembles the category it belongs to.
